verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents a public REST API for triggering deployments, embedding the AI assistant, exporting analytics and managing documentation programmatically (mintlify-docs-21). Specific documented endpoints exist for queuing deployment updates with status tracking and for creating or redeploying branch preview deployments (mintlify-docs-48, mintlify-docs-49). Missing for 10: detailed evidence of content- or page-level management endpoints beyond deployments and analytics, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.
